conde: conde — count (noun; el conde don Remont 'Count Remont'; = conde)
follón: follón — arrogant, overbearing (adj.; el conde es muy follón 'the count is very arrogant'; the exact shade is uncertain and Pidal gives no note; closest arrogante)
vanidat: vanidat — vanity, empty boast (fem. noun; dixo una vanidat 'spoke a boast'; = vanidad)
tuertos: tuerto — wrong, injury (noun, pl.; grandes tuertos 'great wrongs'; = agravios, tuertos)
cort: cort — court, royal or lordly household (fem. noun; en mi cort 'in my court'; = corte)
tuerto: tuerto — wrong, injury (noun, sg.; tuerto me tovo 'did me wrong'; = agravio)
tovo: tener — he held, he did (strong preterite 3rd sg.; tuerto me tovo 'he did me wrong'; = tuvo)
firióm: ferir + me — struck me (firió, preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic m(e); firióm el sobrino 'the nephew struck me'; = me hirió)
enmendó: enmendar — he made amends for (preterite 3rd sg.; non lo enmendó 'he did not make amends'; = enmendó)
córrem: correr + me — raids on me (corre, present 3rd sg., + enclitic m(e), dative of the person harmed; córrem las tierras 'he raids my lands'; = me corre)
desafié: desafiar — I defied, formally challenged (preterite 1st sg.; non lo desafié 'I did not challenge him'; = desafié, formal breaking of feudal ties)
nil: ni + le — nor ... to him (ni 'nor' + enclitic l(e); nil torné amiztad 'nor withdrew my friendship from him'; = ni le)
torné: tornar — I returned, gave back (preterite 1st sg.); tornar amistad 'to withdraw friendship', the formal step before defiance (Pidal: 'retirar la amistad'; = torné)
amiztad: amiztad — friendship (fem. noun; = amistad; Pidal's [a]mi[z]tad, editorial letters; the el before it is the article el for la)
busca: buscar — he seeks, looks for (present 3rd sg.; quando él me lo busca 'since he seeks it of me'; = busca)
demandar: demandar — to demand, claim, ask for (infinitive; ir gelo he demandar 'I shall go and demand it of him'; split future ir + ge + lo + he, = se lo iré a demandar; = demandar)
llegandos: llegar + se — arriving, gathering (gerund llegando + reflexive s(e), Pidal's llegando[s]; a priessa llegandos van 'they keep gathering in haste'; ir + gerund 'keep on'; = llegándose)
allegan: allegar(se) — they gather, assemble (present 3rd pl., reflexive se le allegan 'gather to him'; = se allegan, closest se juntan)
adeliñan: adeliñar — they head for, make straight for (present 3rd pl.; adeliñan tras mio Çid 'they make straight after my Çid'; = se encaminan, se dirigen)
tras: tras — after, behind (preposition; tras mio Çid 'after the Cid, in pursuit of'; = tras)
penssaron: pensar — they set about (preterite 3rd pl.; pensar de + inf. 'to set about doing'; penssaron de andar 'they set about marching'; = pensaron)
alcançaron: alcançar — they overtook, caught up with (preterite 3rd pl.; = alcanzaron)
cuydan: cuydar — they think, they expect (present 3rd pl., Pidal's cuyda[n]; se le cuydan tomar 'they expect to seize him'; = creen, piensan)
diçe: deçir — he comes down, descends (present 3rd sg.; diçe de una sierra 'he comes down from a range'; Pidal: 'desciende'; not dezir 'to say'; = desciende)
remont: Remont — Ramón, the count of Barcelona's name in the poem (don Remont; in full Remont Verenguel; = Ramón)
lês: les + es — to them is (Pidal's circumflexed contraction: les 'to them' + es, ser as perfect auxiliary of venir; venido lês mensaje 'a message has come to them'; = les ha venido; reading probable, not certain)
enbió: enviar — he sent (preterite 3rd sg.; enbió pora allá 'he sent (messengers) over there'; = envió)
digades: dezir — (that) you say, tell (2nd pl. present subjunctive used as command, polite; digades al conde 'tell the count'; = digáis)
tenga: tener — (that) he hold, take (present subjunctive 3rd sg.; non lo tenga a mal 'let him not take it ill'; = tenga)
lievo: levar — I take, carry off (present 1st sg.; de lo so non lievo nada 'of what is his I take nothing'; = llevo)
déxem: dexar + me — let him leave me (dexe, present subjunctive 3rd sg., + enclitic me; déxem ir en paz 'let him let me go in peace'; = déjeme)
tódom: todo + me — all of it ... to me (todo + enclitic me, dative 'for me'; tódom lo pechará 'he will pay me for all of it'; = todo me)
pechará: pechar — he will pay, pay for (future 3rd sg.; lo pechará 'he shall pay for it'; = pagará)
sabrá: saber — he will know, find out (future 3rd sg.; sabrá el salido 'the exile will find out'; = sabrá)
desondrar: desondrar — to dishonour, insult (infinitive; vino desondrar 'came to dishonour'; = deshonrar)
connosçe: connosçer — he recognizes, realizes (present 3rd sg.; essora lo connosçe 'then he realizes it'; = conoce)
den: den — from there, from it (de + en, the short form of ende 'thence', as dent = de + ent; non pueden den quitar 'they cannot get clear of it'; = de allí, de ello)
apart: apart — aside, apart (adverb; apart fazed la ganançia 'set the booty aside'; = aparte)
fazed: fazer — do, make (imperative 2nd pl.; apart fazed 'set aside'; = haced)
guarnid: guarnir — equip, arm yourselves (imperative 2nd pl.; apriessa vos guarnid 'arm yourselves quickly'; = guarneced, armaos)
metedos: meter + vos — put yourselves (imperative 2nd pl. meted + vos, the v of vos lost: metedvos > metedos; metedos en las armas 'take up your arms'; = meteos)
dexarié: dexar — he would leave (conditional 3rd sg., -ié ending; non nos dexarié 'he would not let us be'; = dejaría)
apretad: apretar — tighten (imperative 2nd pl.; apretad los cavallos 'tighten the (girths of the) horses'; = apretad)
bistades: bestir — (that) you put on (present subjunctive 2nd pl. used as an exhortation; b for v; bistades las armas 'put on your armour'; = vistáis)
cuesta: cuesta — slope, hillside (fem. noun; cuesta yuso 'down the slope'; = cuesta)
yuso: yuso — down, downward (adverb, Latin deorsum; cuesta yuso 'down the slope'; = abajo)
trahen: traer — they bring, they wear (present 3rd pl., h marking the hiatus; todos trahen calças 'all of them wear hose'; = traen)
elas: e + las — and the (e 'and' + fem. pl. article las; elas siellas 'and the saddles'; = y las)
coçeras: coçera — of a kind of saddle (adj., fem. pl.; siellas coçeras, the enemy's saddles, which Pidal (note to v. 1007) calls insecure, set against the siellas gallegas; the exact sense is uncertain)
amojadas: amojado — slack, loose (past part. as adj., fem. pl.; las cinchas amojadas 'the girths slack'; Pidal gives no note and the sense is uncertain)
cavalgaremos: cavalgar — we shall ride (future 1st pl.; = cabalgaremos)
gallegas: gallego — Galician (adj., fem. pl.; siellas gallegas 'Galician saddles', set against the enemy's siellas coçeras; = gallegas)
huesas: huesa — high boot, riding boot (pl.; huesas sobre calças 'boots over hose'; = botas)
devemos: dever — we must, we are bound to (present 1st pl.; devemos vençer 'we are bound to defeat'; = debemos)
llaño: llaño — plain, level ground (masc. noun; a llaño 'onto the plain'; = llano)
presentémosles: presentar + les — let us present to them (present subjunctive 1st pl. presentemos + enclitic les, the s of -mos kept; presentémosles las lanças 'let us meet them with our lances'; = presentémosles)
firgades: ferir — (that) you strike (present subjunctive 2nd pl., with -g- stem; por uno que firgades 'for each one you strike'; = hiráis)
verá: veer — he will see (future 3rd sg.; verá Remont 'Ramón will see'; = verá)
verenguel: Verenguel — Berenguer, the count of Barcelona's second name (Remont Verenguel; = Berenguer)
tollerme: toller + me — to take from me (toller 'to take away' + enclitic me; por tollerme la ganançia 'in order to take my booty from me'; = quitarme)
adobados: adobar — equipped, ready (past part. masc. pl.; todos son adobados 'all are ready'; = pertrechados, aderezados)
fablado: fablar — spoken (past part.; quando esto ovo fablado 'when he had said this'; = hablado)
presas: prender — taken up, taken (past part. fem. pl.; las armas avién presas 'they had taken up their arms'; = presas)
sedién: seer — they were sitting, they sat (imperfect 3rd pl. of seer 'to sit'; sedién sobre los cavallos 'they sat on their horses'; = estaban sentados)
fuerça: fuerça — force, host, army (fem. noun; la fuerça de los francos 'the host of the Franks'; = fuerza)
francos: franco — Frank (masc. pl.; los francos, the Catalans: Pidal notes that historians of the twelfth century still call them so, Catalonia having been a march of the Carolingian empire; = francos)
fondón: fondón — bottom, foot (masc. noun; al fondón de la cuesta 'at the bottom of the slope'; = fondo)
enpleando: enplear — using, plying (gerund; las van enpleando 'they go on plying them'; ir + gerund 'keep on'; = empleando)
derrocando: derrocar — throwing down, unhorsing (gerund; a los otros derrocando 'unhorsing others'; Pidal: 'derribando'; = derribando)
vençido: vençer — won, defeated (past part.; vençido a 'has won', with a (= ha) after the participle; vençido a esta batalla 'he has won this battle'; = ha vencido)
preson: preson — prison, captivity (fem. noun; a preson le a tomado 'he has taken him prisoner'; = prisión)
hi: hi — there, in it (adverb, variant of i from Latin ibi; hi gañó a Colada 'there he won Colada'; = allí)
colada: Colada — Colada, a sword, won by the Çid at Tévar (hi gañó a Colada 'there he won Colada'; = Colada)
vale: valer — it is worth (present 3rd sg.; que más vale de mill marcos 'which is worth more than a thousand marks'; = vale)
ondró: ondrar — he honoured, made honoured (preterite 3rd sg.; por o ondró su barba 'through which he honoured his beard'; = honró)
prísole: prender + le — he took him (priso, strong preterite 3rd sg., + enclitic le; prísole al comde 'he took the count'; = le prendió)
creenderos: creendero — trusted servant (noun, pl.; Pidal: 'servidor fiel'; a sos creenderos 'to his trusted men'; = hombres de confianza)
mandava: mandar — he ordered, was ordering (imperfect 3rd sg.; a sos creenderos guardar lo mandava 'he told his trusted men to guard him'; = mandaba)
ajuntavan: ajuntar(se) — they were gathering, assembled (imperfect 3rd pl. in -avan, Pidal's ajunta[van], reflexive sense 'gathered themselves'; = se juntaban)
cozínal: cozina + l(e) — cooked food, a meal, for him (cozina, Pidal 'vianda o comida aderezada al fuego', + enclitic l(e), dative, resuming A mio Çid; grant cozínal adobavan 'they were preparing a great meal for him'; a pronoun leaning on a noun is unusual and the analysis is uncertain; = comida)
adobavan: adobar — they prepared, were preparing (imperfect 3rd pl.; = adobaban, aderezaban)
adúzenle: aduzir + le — they bring to him (aduzen present 3rd pl. + enclitic le; = le traen; aduzir = to bring, lead)
comeres: comer — food, dishes (masc. noun, pl., nominalised infinitive; adúzenle los comeres 'they bring him the dishes'; = comidas)
quiere: querer — he wants (present 3rd sg.; non lo quiere comer 'he will not eat it'; = quiere)
sosañava: sosañar — he was scorning, mocking (imperfect 3rd sg.; a todos los sosañava 'he looked down on them all'; = despreciaba, desdeñaba)
combré: comer — I shall eat (future 1st sg. comré with epenthetic b; non combré un bocado 'I will not eat a morsel'; = comeré)
perderé: perder — I shall lose, let go (future 1st sg.; antes perderé el cuerpo 'rather shall I lose my body'; = perderé)
cuerpo: cuerpo — body (= cuerpo; perder el cuerpo 'to lose one's life')
dexaré: dexar — I shall leave, give up (future 1st sg.; dexaré el alma 'I shall give up the soul'; = dejaré)
tales: tal — such (pl., both genders; tales malcalçados 'such ill-shod men'; = tales)
malcalçados: malcalçado — badly shod (adj. as noun, masc. pl., mal + calçado; a sneer at the Çid's men; Pidal notes that malcalzado was used as a nickname; = malcalzados)
vençieron: vençer — they defeated (preterite 3rd pl.; me vençieron de batalla 'defeated me in battle'; = vencieron)

__broaden__.sea: seer — may be, that is (present subjunctive 3rd sg.) · also 'let it be' as a hortatory subjunctive (aquí sea la batalla 'let the battle be here')
__broaden__.menos: menos — least, less · menos fallar — to find missing, to miss (de los sos menos non fallaron 'of their own men they missed no more than fifteen') · also a menos de — 'without, short of' (a menos de batalla non pueden den quitar 'short of a battle they cannot get clear of it')
__broaden__.antes: antes — before; antes de 'before' · also antes que — 'before' (conjunction; antes quel prendan 'before they take him') · also antes — 'rather' (antes perderé el cuerpo 'rather shall I lose my body')
__broaden__.paravan: parar(se) — they took their stand, halted (imperfect 3rd pl., reflexive; = paraban) · also parar — to set, place, transitive (delant gelos paravan 'they set them before him'; = ponían)
__broaden__.preçia: preçiar — to value, prize (present; preçia' with Pidal's apostrophe = preçian, 3rd pl., its n merged with the n of a following nada: non preçia' nada 'they prize it at nothing'; = precian, aprecian) · also preçia — he values (present 3rd sg.; non gelo preçia nada 'he cares nothing for it'; = aprecia)
__broaden__.verdad: verdad — truth (dezir vos he la verdad 'I shall tell you the truth'; = verdad) · also non será verdad — 'it shall not be so' (Pidal: 'esto no será así'; esto non será verdad)
__broaden__.de: de — of, from · also de — by (the agent with a passive participle; = por) · also de — 'by (night)' (de noch), partitive 'of, among' (quinze moros … de los que alcançava; pocas de gentes), 'as' (de ganançia 'as booty'), 'from outside' (de fuera), 'on the right' (de diestro) · also 'about, concerning' (de mí non digan mal 'let them not speak ill of me') · also de — 'as if in' (commo de arrancada 'as if in rout'); 'in the manner of' (de guisa 'in such a way'); 'of, among' (de bivos pocos 'of the living few'); nominalized infinitive (del prender 'of the taking') · also de — 'with' of manner (de fuertes coraçones 'with stout hearts'); 'on' (de pie 'on foot'); 'from' of side (della e della part 'from both sides'); de cabo 'anew' (de + cabo, 'again'); de suso de 'above'; seños … de seños colpes 'with one blow each' · also de — 'in respect of' after an adjective (sobejana de mala 'exceedingly bad'); 'with regard to, about' (me plaze de mio Çid 'I am pleased about the Cid'); 'from, at the hand of' (de señor non ha graçia 'he gets no favor from a lord'); 'from' of origin (de moros fo 'it came from Moors'); 'at' of manner (de vagar 'at leisure', de + the noun vagar) · also de’ — Pidal's de’llaño, read as del llaño 'of the plain' (the article's l run into the ll; a reading, not certain)
__broaden__.mal: mal — harm, hurt, ruin · mal — evil, in the prayer's sense (por end es salvo de mal 'therefore he is saved from evil') · also mal — adverb 'sorely, ill' (por cuer le pesó mal 'it grieved him sorely at heart') · also tener a mal — 'to take amiss' (non lo tenga a mal 'let him not take it amiss')
